## Plan-review v3/v4 — mechanical blocks cleared

- **v3 BLOCK (P4 oversize):** description was 9615 chars (>8000). Trimmed to ~6.7k by moving RCA/remediation narration into these comments; kept problem, constraints, all 11 ACs, and the plan. LLM had not run at v3 (structural gate). No substance change.
- **v4 BLOCK (E4 citation):** while trimming I abbreviated the schema path to `schemas/fsck.schema.json`; the real file is `src/rebar/schemas/fsck.schema.json`. Fully-qualified that and the other primary src paths in the plan, and corrected the same pre-existing loose path in the `FsckOut` docstring I was editing. All other v4 criteria (P1–P3, P5–P11, and the LLM G6 substance) PASSED. Re-running review-plan.
